runs.text: ANTICHRIST:
1. How many antichrists are there?
1 John 2:18
Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come,
even now are there many antichrists
; whereby we know that it is the last time.
Note:
Most people believe only in a specific antichrist that comes in the last time. But the Bible tells us that there are many antichrists, and even in the apostle John’s day there were many antichrists.
Is antichrist a person who comes in the last time, or is antichrist a doctrine that changes the nature of Jesus into a different, (anti-Jesus), or (anti-Christ)?
The answer is both.

A person who denies the Father and Son, (1 Jo 2:22) or does not believe that Jesus Himself comes in our flesh (2 Jo 1:7) is antichrist. The “last time” man of sin in 2 Thess 2:3 is an antichrist because he promotes these false antichrist doctrines.
DEFINITION OF ANTICHRIST #1
ANTICHRIST DENIES THE FATHER AND SON:
2. What does antichrist deny?
1 John 2:22
Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ?
He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
Note:

The foundational doctrine of the Catholic Church is the trinity doctrine. The Catholic trinity doctrine teaches that Jesus is eternal, and therefore could not ever be a real son. They also teach that Jesus is ever coming forth from God, so He could never ever really arrive. It is in this sense that the church denies the Father and Son. These are antichrist doctrines.

The Protestants’ antichrist doctrine is called the godhead. It denies the Father and Son by teaching three co-eternal beings that have always existed. If Jesus has always existed, then God could not really be the Father of Christ. In this sense the Protestant godhead also denies that there is a literal Son of God. Many are aware that they deny that God sent a literal son. These Protestant apostates present the word son, and the word father as mere metaphors, not literal.

Both Catholics and these Protestants teach that God and His Son exist, but in effect they deny them both by denying a true literal Son! If antichrist is being taught in your circle, you should stand against it.
The Bible is clear, God did send His real literal Son. God did not send a metaphor! (See John 3:16-17)
THE SON OF GOD BECAME THE SON OF MAN:
3. What did Jesus become at Bethlehem?
Matthew 16:13
Jesus asked his disciples, saying,
Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?
And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
And
Jesus answered and said unto him… flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven
Note:
In heaven, Jesus was the begotten “
Son of the living God.
” At Bethlehem, He became the s
on of man
The Bible teaches that the Son of God became the son of man at Bethlehem. So yes, God sent His literal divine son from heaven to pay the penalty for our sins!
4. Is Jesus Divine?
1 Timothy 3:16
God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
Note:
The Son of God existed before becoming the Son of Man. This means that God sent His divine Son to redeem man.
John 1:14
: The Word became flesh and dwelt among us.
Colossians 2:9
For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead (“deity” See Strong’s) bodily.
5. How did Jesus become Divine?
John 5:26
For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself.
Note:
Jesus is divine by inheritance. (See Heb 1:4) He received all things, including His divinity from His Father. Jesus is divine because He is God’s son. He is the subordinate, divine Son.
DEFINITION OF ANTICHRIST # 2
DENIES CHRIST IN US:
6. What is a deceiver called that denies that Jesus is come in the flesh?
2 John 1:7
For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ
is come
in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
Note
: The words, “
Jesus Christ “
is come
” in the flesh
” is not about Jesus’s birth in Bethlehem. Instead, it examines whether Jesus is present in believers today, specifically at this present moment.
The phrase “
is come
” does not say, “
has come two thousand years ago
”! The phrase “i
s come

” is in the present tense, meaning right now! It is speaking about Christ living in us as the Comforter today! (See tract #9 “The Holy Spirit”) This is profound! It makes all the difference in the world to have Christ’s heart, and His capacity to love others within us.
7. What are those called who do not confess that Jesus came in the flesh?
1 John 4:3
And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ
is come
in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist,
whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.
Note:
Once again, “
is come
” is in the present tense. It means that right now Christ is dwelling in you! It means that right now Christ is helping you!

The "man of sin" (Papal Rome) promotes a doctrine denying that Christ dwells within believers. The Trinity doctrine suggests a third, unnamed holy spirit god resides in and aids humanity. However, Scripture teaches that Christ Himself indwells, and comforts us.
8. How do we know 1 John 4:3 is speaking about Christ dwelling in our flesh today?
1 John 4:4
Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is
he that is in you
, than he that is in the world.
Note:
In 1 John 4:3, 4 the context refers to “
he that is in you
,” meaning Christ dwelling within believers. We are warned that anyone who denies that it is Christ, or claims that a different spirit, or god is residing in us is promoting antichrist.
9. How are we to test (try) the spirits?
1John 4:1
Beloved, believe not every spirit, but
try the spirits whether they are of God
: because many false prophets are gone out into the world. 2 Hereby know ye the Spirit of God:
Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ
is come
in the flesh is of God
Note:
The way that we test the false prophets and teachers is that:
“Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ “
is come
” in the flesh
is of God

Every teacher that denies that it is Christ Himself that comes in believers’ flesh to aid in overcoming sin is antichrist. Many literally teach that it is a third un-named spirit god in the place of the “Spirit of Christ”!
I WILL COME UNTO YOU:
10. Who “shall” dwell in the believer?
John 14:17
Even the Spirit of truth
; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him;
for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.
I will not leave you
comfortless
I will come to you
Note:
John tells us that Jesus promised to never leave us without a comforter.
Jesus promises his followers that He is their Comforter. (See tract 9, “The Holy Spirit”) He dwelleth with them and shall be in them.
In a little while the world will see Him no more, but they would see Him. Jesus tells His apostles plainly “
I will come to you
.” Jesus promised His disciples that He would soon dwell in them.
11. Who is the Holy Spirit?
2 Corinthians 3:17
Now the Lord is that Spirit
: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
Note:
The Lord is that Spirit. Many only realize what this is saying after someone points it out to them. Christ in His Spirit form is the Holy Spirit. (See tract #9 “The Holy Spirit”)
The Bible never calls the spirit “God the Holy Spirit”. It says, the “Spirit of Christ”, “Spirit of God”, or, the “Spirit of the Lord”!
CHRIST IS EVER WITH US IN SPIRIT:
12. How would Jesus remain with them?
Colossians 2:5
For though I be absent in the flesh,
yet am I with you in the spirit
”, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.
Note:
Even though Jesus was far away in heaven and was absent in the flesh, He was still present with them
in the Spirit
. He is present right now. Walk ye in Him!
13. How do we receive and walk in Christ?
Colossians 2:6
As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him
Note:
We have to receive Christ in Spirit by faith. He is absent with us in flesh, yet He is with us in Spirit. We must receive him by faith, not by sight. He dwells within us and by faith we walk in Him.
14. What did Jesus promise us?
Hebrews 13:5
I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee
Note:
Jesus has kept His promise. By faith He remains with us, and dwells in us today.
15. How long will Jesus remain with us?
Matthew 28:20
Lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen
Note:
Is Jesus with us today? By faith Jesus will remain with believers even to the end of the world!
16. Will the Father dwell with the believer also?
John 14:23
Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and
my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him
Note:
Both the Father and His Son will come and make their abode with those who love Him and keep His words.
COME BOLDLY TO HIM:
17. Who alone can help us in our time of need?
Hebrews 4:15
For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin
Let us therefore come
boldly
unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need
Note:
Christ is currently (
afar off
) in the most holy place in heaven ministering for His people. But at the same time, He is present with us here and now in spirit. What this means is that Jesus is not (
afar off
), He is (
nigh at hand
). He has never left nor forsaken us. We can come
boldly
to the throne of grace!
IDENTIFYING THE ANTICHRIST SYSTEM:
18. What does the man of sin (anti-christ) claim?
2 Thessalonians 2:3
Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that
man of sin
be revealed,
the son of perdition
Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.
Note:
The man of sin / son of perdition claims to be God. This would make the son of perdition an “anti-god” by claiming to be God.
19. Who is the man of sin?
Daniel 7:24
And the ten horns out of this kingdom are ten kings that shall arise: and another shall rise after them; and he shall be diverse from the first, and
he shall subdue
three
kings
And he shall speak great words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High, and think to change times and laws.
Note:
Most Bibles cross reference the “man of sin” with Daniel 7:24-25. The identity of the man of sin (anti-christ) is found in verse 24.
Daniel 7:24 “
and he shall subdue
three
kings
The antichrist system is the beast power that indirectly subdued three Arian (Non-trinitarian) nations of Europe. This beast was the papacy.
THE LITTLE HORN:
Destroyed three nations
20. What did the little horn pluck up?
Daniel 7:8
I considered the horns, and, behold,
there came up among them another little horn, before whom there were
three
of the first horns plucked up by the roots:
Note:

Finding a nation that subdued three nations on its rise to consolidate power is the key for identifying antichrist. The Ostrogoths, Vandals, and Heruli were European nations that no longer exist because the papacy indirectly uprooted them.

The “little horn”, “antichrist”, “son of perdition”, “man of sin”, and the “beast of Revelation 13” are all the same entity! Each of these Biblical terms are speaking about the papacy. The papacy destroyed three kingdoms of Europe that were Arian (
non-trinitarian
) on its rise to consolidate its power. This identifies the papacy as antichrist.
21. Whom did the Little Horn make war with?
Daniel 7:20
And of the other which came up, and
before whom
three
fell;
even of that horn that had eyes, and
a mouth that spake very great things
, whose look was more stout than his fellows. 21 I beheld, and the same horn
made war with the saints, and prevailed against them.
Note:

The Ostrogoths, Vandals, and Heruli rejected the trinity. The Papacy indirectly destroyed them. It is estimated that the Papal church caused the death of up to 50 million people during its 1260 year reign. Many of these were burned at the stake for no other crime but heresy. (
See Fox’s Book of Martyrs
) (The Vatican disputes the number of people slain.)
Reference:
“The church may by divine right confiscate the property of heretics, imprison their persons,
and condemn them to the flames
The right to inflict the severest penalties, even death, belongs to the church
There is no graver offense than heresy… therefore it must be rooted out
(Papal Public Ecclesiastical Law, Volume 2, page 142. 9)
SUMMARY:

Over the last two thousand years, the devil has deployed the "little horn," "antichrist," "son of perdition," "man of sin," and "beast of Revelation 13" in a total onslaught attack against the true church.

The papacy, during its rise to power, indirectly contributed to the demise of three Arian (non-trinitarian) kingdoms, identifying it as antichrist. This clear identifying factor, and its false doctrines about the Father and Son identify this system as antichrist!
22. Who did the founders of most Protestant denominations identify as antichrist?
Martin Luther:
We here are of the conviction that the papacy is the seat of the true and real Anti-christ
…personally I declare that I owe the Pope no other obedience than that to Antichrist." (Aug. 18, 1520) Taken from "The Prophetic Faith of Our Fathers," Vol. 2, pg. 121 by Froom.
John Calvin:
(1509-1564) (Presbyterian)
Some persons think us too severe and censorious when we call the Roman pontiff Anti-christ

. But those who are of this opinion do not consider that they bring the same charge of presumption against Paul himself, after whom we speak and whose language we adopt...I shall briefly show that (Paul's words in II Thess. 2) are not capable of any other interpretation than that which applies them to the Papacy." Taken from "Institutes" by John Calvin.
Cotton Mather:
(1663-1728) (Congregational Theologian)

The oracles of God foretold the rising of an Anti-christ in the Christian Church; and in the Pope of Rome, all the characteristics of that Anti-christ are so marvelously answered that if any who read the Scriptures do not see it, there is a marvelous blindness upon them
." Taken from "The Fall of Babylon" by Cotton Mather.
John Knox:
(1505-1572) (Scotch Presbyterian)
Knox wrote to abolish "that tyranny which the pope himself has for so many ages exercised over the church" and
that the pope should be recognized as "the very anti-christ
, and son of perdition, of whom Paul speaks." Taken from "The Zurich Letters" pg. 199 by John Knox.
Thomas Cranmer:
"Whereof it followeth
Rome to be the seat of anti-christ, and the pope to be very anti-christ himself.
Taken from "Works" by Cranmer, Vol. 1, pp. 6-7.
John Wesley:
(1703-1791) (Methodist)
Speaking of the Papacy he said, "He is in an emphatical sense, the Man of Sin
, as he increases all manner of sin above measure. And he is, too, properly styled
the Son of Perdition

, as he has caused the death of numberless multitudes, both of his opposers and followers...He it is...that exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshiped...claiming the highest power, and highest honor...claiming the prerogatives which belong to God alone." Taken from “Anti-christ and His Ten Kingdoms" by John Wesley, pg. 110.
Roger Williams:
(1603-1683) (First Baptist Pastor in America)

He spoke of the Pope as "the pretended Vicar of Christ on earth, who sits as God over the Temple of God, exalting himself not only above all that is called God, but over the souls and consciences of all his vessals, yea over the Spirit of Christ, over the Holy Spirit, yea, and God himself...speaking against the God of heaven, thinking to changed times and laws: but
he is the son of perdition
(II Thess. 2)." Taken from "The Prophetic Faith of Our Fathers" by Froom, Vol. 3, pg. 52.
Note:
Denying the Father and the Son is antichrist. Denying that Jesus comes in our flesh today is also antichrist.
Anyone who teaches these errors is an antichrist!
